security_concerns.summary: The new tilt driver enforces PID/liveness before every message only in hover mode; its input mode bypasses that fence.
security_concerns.detail: Input mode discovers an owned HWND once, then calls inherited post_click plus local message/key without GetWindowThreadProcessId or process.poll before each PostMessageW. This contradicts the requested owned-PID-before-EACH-message constraint. On a stale/reused HWND it can post mouse/key/WM_CHAR messages to a different process. The real final input run passed, and there is no evidence that it sent foreign input; the defect is the missing safety enforcement, not a claimed observed cross-process incident.
